harper: Quick heads-up — running tenant_lookup_index_swap tonight 02:00 UTC. tagging @lee @dmitri. deploy-bot scheduled. rehearsal showed brief lock spikes.

lee: Ack. Abort criteria?

dmitri: Abort if replica_lag > 12s or ANY lock_wait > 8s for >45s. Rollback = pin schema to v20251120_03 and disable flag tenants.lookup_swap. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lookup-swap

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled migration 'tenant_lookup_index_swap' for 2025-11-20T02:00Z. Canary 4% then 25% -> 100%.

lee: I'll flip short write-freeze at -2m.

harper: Preflight sample: `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_lookup WHERE needs_swap` -- ~53k rows.

dmitri: If lock pressure observed, pause background job 'lookup_fill' and drop canary to 1%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started 02:00Z routing 4%. metrics: +2ms latency, 5xx 0.1%.

lee: flipped flag at 01:58 :white_check_mark: queued lookup_fill but will pause on contention.

dmitri: Replica lag 3s -> 9s in 7m. Reduce canary to 1% and pause job.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scaled canary to 1% and paused 'lookup_fill'.

harper: Decision: hold 1% for 10m. Escalate if lag > 15s or lock_wait >10s. Rollback if user errors >0.4% or 5xx spike.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary complete at 02:15Z; no abort. advancing to wave2 25%.

lee: Adding release-note line: "tenant_lookup_index swap — phased canary, short write-freeze, backfill pause on contention."
